text:
anna-partnerships: Quick pulse — planning a short sync with Derek and runtime to lock the driver pin for the May marketplace bundle. can we confirm a candidate today? :eyes:
marcus-eng-runtime: I'm +1 on picking a single pinned driver for CI and the marketplace AMIs. prefer a conservative pin (latest n-1). Any major regression signals?
sophia-qa: We saw a sporadic perf dip on CUDA 12.1 + cudnn 8.4 in nightly last week (p50 latency spikes). not consistent but flagged.
derek-hw-partner: We ran stress tests on our side. CUDA 12.2 driver fixes an ABI quirk for our hw, but it exposed a runtime kernel fallback that increases mem usage on 80-series GPUs. tradeoff.
kevin-sre: For Dedicated and Private customers we should offer a fallback lane: pinned-driver + compatibility-driver group. fallback policy documented in marketplace listing.
marcus-eng-runtime: Suggestion: pin to driver 535.86 (example) for marketplace AMIs, and publish a compatibility matrix that includes 535.86 + 525.x as fallback. sample config: 
```
DRIVER_PIN=535.86
FALLBACK_DRIVERS=[525.60, 520.29]
KERNEL_MIN=5.10
```
anna-partnerships: @derek-hw-partner can you confirm vendor ok with 535.86 for joint announcement (we don't want to call out versions until partner OK)? also any hotfix window constraints?
derek-hw-partner: 535.86 is acceptable as primary. we'll hold a hotfix branch for 535.86-compat if memory regressions hit customers. hotfix ETA depends on severity; minor patches ~2 business days.
sophia-qa: I'll run targeted regression suites overnight against 535.86 and the fallback set. I'll post results in the morning.
marcus-eng-runtime: We should also bake a canary in the marketplace staging region and enable telemetry for kernel OOM / mem-growth signals. kevin, can SRE expose a per-AMI metric for 99th token-latency and GPU memory high-water?
kevin-sre: yes — we'll create a dashboard and alert. naming: marketplace.driver.pin.99latency and marketplace.driver.mem.hwm. will share perms.
deploy-bot: Deployment job started: marketplace-ami-staging (driver=535.86) — job 38291. ETA 18m.
anna-partnerships: solid. after Sophia's run and canary results, we'll call partner and schedule announcement freeze. thanks all :thumbsup:
marcus-eng-runtime: one more ask — add a short rollback playbook to the marketplace docs: steps, contact owners, and automatic rollback threshold (e.g., +30% p99). I can draft.
derek-hw-partner: we'll add partner-side contact + emergency build.
sophia-qa: posting regression summary tomorrow 09:00 PT.
kevin-sre: dashboard link: https://grafana.internal.redwood/marketplace-driver (will invite team).
anna-partnerships: great — locking this thread for action items: 1) Sophia: regression run (first_message_ts 3401209123) 2) Marcus: draft rollback playbook 3) Kevin: dashboard + alerts 4) Derek: confirm hotfix cadence and emergency contact. follow-up in #partnerships tomorrow.
